adjudication.reason: The frozen 600-second timeout guardian terminated the native SparseElimination route before the driver emitted its terminal JSON or solution. The wrapper attempted stdout parsing before resource classification and therefore wrote an integrity-failure label that does not describe the process-level outcome.
adjudication.route_instruction: Move to the preregistered 114-dimensional Koszul quotient or a materially different black-box solver. Do not license the explicit target solve from this experiment.

claim_boundary: This receipt adjudicates only the resource outcome of the synthetic-known-vector solver-capability experiment. It proves no target membership or nonmembership, no rational identity, no colon or saturation equality, no secant closure, no nullcone containment, and no HC4 statement.

wrapper_defect.description: The v2 wrapper required exactly one stdout line before checking the resource outcome returned by the supervisor. A timeout necessarily leaves stdout empty and was caught by the generic integrity exception.
wrapper_defect.future_fix: Classify return code, wall, RSS, and swaps before parsing stdout; parse driver JSON only for process-level success.
